title: CIA offer to head an ELF research department, brought by Bob Beck

tellings.quote: had been approached by the CIA to head up a ELF research uh department basically.

plain: Sometime between 1977 and 1979, a man named Bob Beck is said to have come to the house of Andrija Puharich, the scientist this episode is about, with word that the CIA, the US spy agency, wanted someone to head a research department on ELF, meaning extremely low frequency radio waves. A researcher on the episode, who is not named, tells it in summary and says it rests on Puharich's own handwritten notes on a legal pad. If it happened, it would mean the spy agency was quietly looking for people to lead work on these waves.
